source_provenance: Only frozen public repository source plus compact technical run metadata; native full instruction/session streams remain in native stores.
limits: Pattern scan is not a universal privacy classifier; existing source authority prose reviewed against private-data categories.

prose_boundary_review.method: Bounded LLM read of the newly written review captions, source-linked investigation result, compact trace/refusal records and issue comment against workspace private-data categories. No separate API call or model override.
checked_boundaries: No credentials, account identity fields or raw native message/instruction streams copied into the commit.
Frozen source comes from existing public Git revisions, not private memory, Second Brain or messages.
Run identifiers, paths, source revisions, tool settings and token counts are technical provenance.
No contact, health, salary, job-search, customer or internal company records are included.
prose_boundary_review.scope: New prose and compact native evidence; unchanged public source blobs are verified by Git provenance and hashes.
